description: Server-derived account-scope invariant. The server derives the account from @request.auth.id (PocketBase) or pb_auth.current_user (runner); clients never choose or override ownership. This file is the rule table every account-scoped collection must satisfy. A leaf that changes a listed rule or adds a user-owned collection edits its row in the same PR. Read by harness/probes, #172 (authorization matrix), and #1's security inventory.

list.guarantee: owner-filtered list; another account's rows are absent

view.guarantee: another account's record is not found

update.guarantee: another account's or an anonymous update is not found

delete.guarantee: another account's record is not found and is unchanged

oversized_input.guarantee: a JSON field over its maxSize fails validation

signup_disabled.guarantee: signup is rejected when ROUNDS_DISABLE_SIGNUPS is set

create_foreign_owner.guarantee: a create whose user is not the caller is rejected

update_reassign.guarantee: an update that reassigns user is not found under the owner rule

server_only.guarantee: a client list, view, create, update, or delete on a collection whose rule for it is null is forbidden

update_own.guarantee: an account's update of its own row succeeds

superuser_create.guarantee: a superuser insert on a server-only collection succeeds

auth_unavailable.guarantee: the runner refuses with auth_unavailable when it cannot verify the caller

relation_create.guarantee: a create pointing a typed relation at a target the account does not own is rejected

relation_update.guarantee: an update pointing a typed relation at a target the account does not own is not found

open_exceptions.note: response timing is not compared between another account's records and missing ones
error shapes beyond the user id case are not compared

a create naming a missing owner and one naming another account are both denied with the same status (account-scope.create.nonexistent-owner.denied); PocketBase checks that the named user exists before the create rule runs, so the error bodies are not compared here

a create may supply its own record id, and PocketBase validates that id before the create rule runs, so the response to a taken id differs from the response to a free one and can tell whether a record with that id exists in any account; the uniform relation denial covers the ids a row points at, not the new row's own id

deployment.proxy.admin-ui.denied.guarantee: the PocketBase admin UI is not served at the public URL

deployment.proxy.admin-api.denied.guarantee: the PocketBase admin API, including admin login, is not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.settings-api.denied.guarantee: PocketBase settings are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.backups-api.denied.guarantee: PocketBase backups are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.logs-api.denied.guarantee: PocketBase logs are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.collection-metadata.den.guarantee: collection schema routes are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.admission-hooks.denied.guarantee: the admission hook routes are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.execution-hooks.denied.guarantee: the execution job store's hook routes are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.execution-service.denie.guarantee: the execution service record, its login included, is not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.legacy-snapshot-hook.de.guarantee: the legacy snapshot hook, which only the runner calls, is not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.execute.gone.guarantee: /api/execute no longer reaches a code runner

deployment.proxy.health.open.guarantee: the health route still reaches PocketBase

deployment.proxy.oauth-redirect.open.guarantee: the OAuth redirect route still reaches PocketBase

deployment.proxy.realtime.open.guarantee: the realtime stream still reaches PocketBase

deployment.proxy.oversized-body.rejected.guarantee: a body over the default 1 MiB cap gets the typed 413

deployment.credentials.defaults.rejected.guarantee: no shipped default login authenticates as an admin

deployment.credentials.admin-passwords.r.guarantee: no admin account accepts a shipped default password

deployment.rules.match.guarantee: the collection rules match the account-scope rule table

deployment.admins.present.guarantee: at least one admin exists, so first-admin setup is closed

deployment.proxy.share-page.headers.guarantee: every path that renders the share page answers the app page with no-store, noindex, no-referrer, nosniff, DENY framing, and the share page CSP

deployment.proxy.share-read.uniform.guarantee: a public share read of a malformed or unknown token answers one byte-identical 404 with no-store, noindex, no-referrer, nosniff, DENY framing, and the resolver CSP

deployment.proxy.share-hooks.denied.guarantee: the share capability hook routes, which only the runner calls, are not reachable at the public URL

deployment.proxy.share-resolve.uniform.guarantee: a share capability resolve with a malformed or unknown token answers one byte-identical 404 with no-store, noindex, no-referrer, nosniff, DENY framing, and the resolver CSP

deployment.proxy.share-resolvers.denied.guarantee: the share resolver record, its login included, is not reachable at the public URL

server_derivation.superuser_bypass: superuser requests and $app.dao() writes bypass collection rules; hook routes rely on this

account-scope.list.cross-account.isolate.guarantee: a signed-in account's list never returns another account's rows

account-scope.list.anonymous.isolated.guarantee: an anonymous list returns none of an account's rows

account-scope.view.cross-account.denied.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot read another account's record by id

account-scope.view.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot read an account's record by id

account-scope.update.cross-account.denie.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot update another account's record

account-scope.update.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot update an account's record

account-scope.delete.cross-account.denie.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot delete another account's record

account-scope.delete.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot delete an account's record

account-scope.create.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot create a row

account-scope.oversized-input.rejected.guarantee: a JSON field larger than its maxSize is rejected

account-scope.signup.disabled.denied.guarantee: signup is rejected when the instance disables signups

account-scope.create.foreign-owner.denie.guarantee: a create whose user is not the caller is rejected

account-scope.update.reassign-owner.deni.guarantee: an update that reassigns a row to another account is rejected

account-scope.update.own.accepted.guarantee: an account's update of its own row (omitting user or resending its own) still succeeds

account-scope.create.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client create on a server-only collection is forbidden

account-scope.update.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client update on a collection whose update rule is null is forbidden, even the owner's, and the row is unchanged

account-scope.delete.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client delete on a collection only the server writes is forbidden, even the owner's

account-scope.create.superuser.accepted.guarantee: a superuser insert on a server-only collection still succeeds

account-scope.list.filter.isolated.guarantee: a list filtered on another account's record or account id returns none of its rows

account-scope.view.foreign-or-missing.in.guarantee: reading another account's record gets the same status and JSON body as reading one that does not exist

account-scope.update.foreign-or-missing..guarantee: updating another account's record gets the same status and JSON body as updating one that does not exist

account-scope.delete.foreign-or-missing..guarantee: deleting another account's record gets the same status and JSON body as deleting one that does not exist

account-scope.create.replayed-denied.den.guarantee: replaying a denied foreign-owner create is denied every time and leaves no row

account-scope.create.nonexistent-owner.d.guarantee: a create naming an owner that does not exist is denied with the same status and leaves no row

account-scope.runner.pocketbase-unreacha.guarantee: with PocketBase unreachable a runner write fails closed before it writes

account-scope.create.relation-foreign.de.guarantee: an account's own row cannot point a typed relation at another account's record

account-scope.create.relation-foreign-or.guarantee: a foreign and a missing relation target are denied alike on create, so neither reveals the target exists

account-scope.create.relation-superuser..guarantee: even the superuser cannot create a row whose typed relation points across accounts

account-scope.update.relation-foreign.de.guarantee: an account cannot repoint its own row's typed relation at another account's record

account-scope.update.relation-foreign-or.guarantee: a foreign and a missing relation target are denied alike on update, so neither reveals the target exists

account-scope.share.owner-only.isolated.guarantee: a share link answers only its owner: another account and an anonymous caller read no link row

account-scope.share.create-shape.denied.guarantee: a share link create without exactly one target or with a malformed token is rejected with the uniform create denial and writes nothing

account-scope.list.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client list on a collection whose list rule is null is forbidden, the owner's own included, and returns no row

account-scope.view.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client read by id on a collection whose view rule is null is forbidden, the owner's own row included

account-scope.share.capability-list.owne.guarantee: the owner's share capability list answers each account with its own capabilities and the owner's fields only, and refuses an anonymous caller

account-scope.share.capability-revoke.fo.guarantee: revoking another account's share capability answers exactly as revoking one that does not exist, and changes nothing

isolation.share-views.client-write.denie.control: none:resume_share_views create and update rules are null
isolation.share-views.client-write.denie.guarantee: no client writes a share view row, for its own link or another account's

isolation.share-link.owner-only.isolated.control: the owner reads its own link
isolation.share-link.owner-only.isolated.guarantee: a share link reads only for its owner, keeps its target once made, and points only at the owner's own resume or variant

isolation.deploy.exposure.denied.guarantee: the PocketBase admin UI and admin API aren't served at the public URL, and no shipped default login opens an admin account

isolation.deploy.share-headers.present.control: the share page renders the app page with the same headers
isolation.deploy.share-headers.present.guarantee: every share page path carries the share headers, and a malformed and an unknown share read answer one byte-identical not-found

isolation.demo.no-share-or-provider.control: a standard account creates a share link, a provider, and AI settings
isolation.demo.no-share-or-provider.guarantee: a demo caller can't create a share link, an AI provider, or AI settings, and no demo account signs in when the demo is off

isolation.execution-jobs.read.foreign.control: the owner reads its own job
isolation.execution-jobs.read.foreign.guarantee: reading another account's execution job answers the same 404 as an unknown job id

isolation.execution-jobs.cancel.foreign.control: the owner cancels its own job
isolation.execution-jobs.cancel.foreign.guarantee: canceling another account's execution job answers the same 404 as an unknown job id and leaves the job as it was

isolation.execution-review.foreign.control: the owner asks for its own review
isolation.execution-review.foreign.guarantee: asking for the review of another account's grading result answers the same 404 as an unknown job id and charges nothing

account-scope.create.owner-shape.uniform.guarantee: a create naming a missing owner and one naming another account answer with the same status and body

account-scope.create.client-id.uniform.control: the caller's own create without an id succeeds
account-scope.create.client-id.uniform.guarantee: a create that brings its own record id answers alike whether that id is taken or free

isolation.share-resolver.not-found.unifo.guarantee: whatever stops a capability from resolving, the answer is one not-found carrying the share headers

isolation.share-resolver.password.unifor.guarantee: a password mismatch answers exactly as an unknown capability does

isolation.share-resolver.throttle.indepe.control: requests under the limit are answered
isolation.share-resolver.throttle.indepe.guarantee: throttling answers the same whether or not the capability exists

isolation.logs.share-secret.absent.control: the same scan finds a value the phase writes to a scratch log on purpose
isolation.logs.share-secret.absent.guarantee: a share capability's secret and its password never appear in a service log or in pb_data

isolation.logs.share-client-address.abse.control: the probe's own address appears in the frontend log for a request outside the share routes
isolation.logs.share-client-address.abse.guarantee: no service log keeps a full client address for a share capability resolve or its page

isolation.share-chain.capability-revoked.control: the capability resolves before it is revoked
isolation.share-chain.capability-revoked.guarantee: once the owner revokes a capability, every path that served it answers as an unknown one

isolation.share-legacy.replaced.guarantee: once legacy share links are replaced, a legacy link answers as an unknown one on every path

isolation.demo.reset.zero-rows.control: the demo session's rows exist before the reset
isolation.demo.reset.zero-rows.guarantee: a demo session's reset leaves no row behind in any collection

isolation.slot.sources.control: the owner reads its own source
isolation.slot.sources.guarantee: another account's source documents and anchors read as missing ones

isolation.slot.processing-jobs.control: the owner reads its own job
isolation.slot.processing-jobs.guarantee: another account's processing jobs read as missing ones

isolation.slot.renderer-caches.guarantee: no render reuses another account's cached output or state

isolation.slot.search.control: the owner finds its own record
isolation.slot.search.guarantee: search returns, counts, and ranks only the caller's own records

isolation.slot.merges.control: the owner merges two of its own records
isolation.slot.merges.guarantee: a merge, redirect, or tombstone never names another account's record

isolation.slot.account-export.control: the owner exports its own account
isolation.slot.account-export.guarantee: an account export holds only the caller's own records

isolation.slot.artifact-revision-shares.control: the owner's own shared revision resolves
isolation.slot.artifact-revision-shares.guarantee: a shared revision reads on its own, with no other record of the account

exceptions.note: a users hook locks is_demo and the demo flags and retires their client writers
